desc: Understand problem: need to check if we can fill -1 entries and permute A to make all A_i + B_i equal to some constant C.

Derive algorithm: If any index has both A_i and B_i known, that sum forces C; all such forced sums must be equal. Also, that forced C must be >= every known A_i and B_i (so the other side can be non-negative). If no index forces C, we can always pick a large enough C, so answer is "Yes".
Implement solve() in Python according to the algorithm.
Test the solution mentally on provided samples (Sample 1: Yes; Sample 2: No; Sample 3: No).
Write final code block with input parsing, logic, and output.
